records.name: Oral taurine / SLC6A6 taurine-transporter deficiency
records.exact_entity: Oral taurine; Burgerstein tablets named in the original loading-test methods. Therapeutic batch and present supply equivalence not authenticated.
records.indication: Biallelic SLC6A6 deficiency with organ- and genotype-specific claims; cardiac dysfunction and viable residual retina assessed separately.
records.stage: Human uncontrolled treatment reports plus patient-cell/heterologous transport evidence.

evidence.transport_units: heterologous cells and patient fibroblasts; not direct organ target engagement
evidence.baseline_stage: Mild hypokinetic cardiomyopathy; normal effort test. Older sibling had advanced macular atrophy; younger sibling retained central photoreceptors.

ocular_outcome.younger_sibling: Reported visual performance improved; central retinal anatomy stable.
ocular_outcome.older_sibling: No restored vision demonstrated in advanced retinal disease.

evidence.unit: one explicitly treated proband among a seven-affected-person observational cohort
evidence.baseline_stage: Advanced retinal degeneration; no dilated cardiomyopathy documented.
evidence.outcome: Examination and full-field stimulus testing essentially unchanged at both follow-ups; plasma normalization without demonstrated visual recovery.

evidence.unit: variant assays; assay repetitions are not patients
evidence.result: Complete or near-complete taurine-transport loss in the tested cell systems. Missense status does not ensure a rescuable hypomorph.

source_discrepancy.handling: Main-text sequence-linked notation retained, with discrepancy explicitly preserved; not a new treated outcome.

records.causal_assessment: Genetic deficiency, residual transport and temporally associated organ improvement support a plausible narrow cardiac signal. Two siblings do not establish independent replication, severe-heart-failure recovery, retinal regeneration, or benefit across transport-null genotypes. Stable late-stage retina has no untreated comparator and cannot establish prevention.
records.comparator_gap: No concurrent untreated or standard-care control; original cardiac cointervention timeline not fully reconstructed.
records.material_model_route: Published loading tablets, exact SLC6A6 constructs and patient fibroblast/HEK assays are public leads only. No material acquired, model commissioned, supply qualification or experiment performed. Transport correction would require useful organ function to justify development.
records.exposure_issue: Plasma taurine correction is not proof of retinal or myocardial intracellular delivery; residual transporter function and remaining tissue must be separated.
records.development_contribution: A genotype/stage/organ-specific evidence and outcome package could define where supplementation adds useful function. Generic taurine availability and an already published treatment idea alone provide no differentiated independent asset.
records.active_developer_and_rights: Academic treatment/variant work is ongoing in the published literature. No exclusive product contribution or complete rights/FTO analysis established; current supply/lot identity unverified.
records.next_decision: Resolve the 2023 two-brother report and complete treated-case lineage before claiming a census; prioritize independent useful cardiac or preserved-vision outcomes with genotype, stage, cointerventions and exposure retained.
records.advance_condition: Independent meaningful organ function beyond plausible care/natural-history effects in a defined genotype and viable-tissue setting; a concrete additional product or evidence contribution is required for asset promotion.
records.stop_condition: Do not generalize absent vision restoration to global taurine failure or presume that plasma normalization rescues lost tissue. Hold an undifferentiated supplementation asset; redirect if adequate exposure in a viable, defined subgroup fails useful function.
records.disposition: conditional clinical-research reserve; independent asset thesis on hold
records.allocation: initial diligence within the existing five-point discovery allocation; no new dedicated allocation

records.name: Zinc acetate dihydrate (Wilzin) / GNAO1-related disorder
records.exact_entity: Wilzin zinc acetate dihydrate capsules, 25 mg or 50 mg elemental zinc per capsule; distinct from zinc gluconate, zinc sulfate, zinc chloride and zinc pyrithione.
records.indication: Genetically confirmed GNAO1-related disorder; useful motor/daily-function benefit remains unproven in a controlled comparison.
records.stage: Completed six-month open-label prospective safety/feasibility pilot plus earlier single case and biochemical studies.

biological_units.mFAS_definition: All enrolled except the participant with an unrelated SAE; therefore includes the never-exposed refuser.

trial.name: ZINCGNAO1
trial.feasibility_definition: adherence on at least 80% of treatment days

exploratory_outcomes.movement_severity: no change; BFMDRS movement was assessed by a blinded rater

reference_comparison.reference: published dyskinetic cerebral palsy standard-care trajectories

earlier_case.new_concomitant_drug: hydromorphone in a palliative respiratory/agitation setting
earlier_case.acute_context: severe infection and respiratory deterioration preceded treatment
earlier_case.abstract_main_text_interpretation: Cessation of daily crises means loss of daily frequency, not disappearance of all crises. Published main text supplies weekly residual crises and unchanged GMFM.

preclinical_transfer_limit.finding_boundary: Rotarod/exploratory gains also occurred in wild-type mice; hyperactivity did not improve. This is not genotype-specific on-target motor rescue and not exact-acetate clinical proof.

records.causal_assessment: Useful function is measured, but open-label maturation, practice, background treatment and expectation remain explanations. The blinded movement-severity null and earlier unchanged GMFM constrain efficacy claims. Nominal pilot P values and an unmatched cerebral-palsy reference do not supply causal efficacy.
records.comparator_gap: Stable and documented disease-specific symptomatic care and an appropriate GNAO1 comparison remain necessary; the study includes polytherapy and prior DBS. No recommendation to interrupt effective care follows from this screen.
records.material_model_route: A named marketed oral article and published variant assays/cell and animal models are public routes. Availability, actual stock, trial supply and qualified assays not established by this screen; nothing acquired or commissioned.
records.exposure_issue: Elemental zinc units must be retained. Serum increase does not establish CNS exposure. Wilson-labelled intestinal copper reduction and swallowing/palatability burdens matter for chronic use in GNAO1.
records.development_contribution: Highest-value incremental work is a genotype-aware controlled useful-function evidence package with transparent exposure/completion and care denominators. A tolerability/administration improvement could be a separate product contribution only if it solves an observed burden; no invasive or novel delivery program is warranted by these data.

active_developer_and_rights.academic_program: University of Cologne and University of Geneva investigators; pilot funded by GNAO1-Gemeinsam nicht allein e.V.

records.next_decision: Recover endpoint-level paired denominators and missing-data handling, and evaluate whether variant responsiveness predicts clinically useful benefit beyond disease-specific comparator care.
records.advance_condition: Controlled, clinically meaningful motor or daily-function benefit, durable enough to matter, with acceptable sustained exposure and a distinct evidence/product contribution beyond the active program.
records.stop_condition: No meaningful controlled function despite adequate exposure, an unacceptable copper/other safety or administration burden, or no differentiated contribution. Retain symptomatic-care access; do not infer a whole-target failure from heterogeneous unresponsive variants.
records.disposition: conditional clinical-research reserve, ahead of taurine for the next bounded clinical-evidence review; independent asset thesis on hold
records.allocation: initial diligence within the existing five-point discovery allocation; no new dedicated allocation
